result.Method of Attack: Steals sensitive information such as user credentials and cookies from browsers and Discord; Exfiltrates stolen data via Discord webhook URLs; Searches specific folders for files related to logins, accounts, and banks and uploads them to file-sharing site transfer.sh
result.Impacted Systems: Systems running Python with these PyPI packages installed; Browsers storing user credentials and cookies; Discord users
result.Attack Vector: Malicious PyPI packages uploaded to Python Package Index; Supply chain attack via malicious Python packages
